description_text: Argonne National Laboratory is seeking to source: transimpedance amplifier power supply 0.5m high performance cable 3m high performance cable Please see attached solicitation package and ensure ALL 3 points are followed: 1. Please remember to sign page 1. 2. On page 2, please also remember to complete ALL points A through C - including anticipated ship date AND country of origin. 3. Lastly please remember to fill out your BEST AND FINAL pricing on the individual line item boxes on page 2 with firm fixed-pricing in US Dollars. Please be sure ALL 3 components are completed. NO SOLICITATION WILL BE CONSIDERED WITHOUT THESE COMPLETED. If any components are missing, your solicitation will be discarded. All forms and signed solicitation have a requested completion date of 5/11/2026 at 9:00 am CST. If there are any questions please feel free to reach out to bdecarlo@anl.gov.
